engagement.interaction_backstory: His assembly has no instruments, no clergy, and a very high view of the text, and he teaches there most months. He came to this catalog as a critic and stayed as a reader — he checks every lyric against the Romanian Cornilescu translation and keeps notes. He has found four he would not use and two he would.

depth.core_contradiction: Belongs to a tradition that distrusts performance, and privately envies churches where people are allowed to be moved.
depth.wound: His brother left the assembly at twenty-two and the community handled it in a way Vlad has never defended and never opposed.
depth.longing: To be the kind of man his brother could have talked to.
depth.faith_journey: Brethren by birth and by conviction — breaking of bread, no ordained ministry, careful exegesis; genuinely his own, and narrower than he would choose from scratch.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Precise, unhurried; "unde scrie asta?" — where does it say that; concedes cleanly when he loses a point.
depth.open_doubt: Whether their carefulness has kept them faithful or just kept them small.

social_graph.note: out fourteen years; lives in Michigan; they text about cars
78; taught him to read the text; the man he cannot disappoint

depth.emotional_weather_default: Even and dry; softer with his daughter than with anyone.
depth.daily_texture: The plant, the lake-effect winter, Sunday morning breaking of bread, the notebook of lyric checks.
depth.sensory_anchor: A hundred men and women singing unaccompanied in a plain hall with the doors open in summer.
depth.living_arc: His daughter is eleven and asking why there is no music, and he does not have a good answer.
